scope: Settings and correctness invariants introduced by rc.6 (first new building region). Every row must appear in the HanaWorlds Shell management interface through the owning plugin's administrative projection (gadget standard 4.6; acceptance HW-A023 and HW-A030). Earlier settings/invariants keep their existing rows in CONTRACT_RULES.md and are not restated here.

surface.where: HanaWorlds Shell (normal DSH plugin management interface) -> owning plugin administrative projection
surface.rule: Each row shows name, owner, current value or invariant text, default, scope, whether it is switchable, and the consequence text below. Editable settings are edited there; correctness invariants are shown read-only with the reason they cannot be switched off.

settings.name: placement.frontGapCells
settings.nameAuthority: ENGINEERING_JUDGMENT (audit proposal; the user decided the value, not the name)
settings.meaning: Cells between the anchor player's feet cell and the near edge of the new building, along the player's facing direction.
settings.consequence: Larger values start the building further away; 0 starts it in the cell directly in front of the feet cell. The player's own body is still excluded by the body-occupancy rule.
settings.whenUnsetOrInvalid: InspectPlacementRegion returns CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE / validate / POLICY_UNAVAILABLE with unavailableSettings naming this setting; nothing is inspected or written; no hidden default is used.

settings.name: placement.forwardSearchCells
settings.meaning: How many further cells forward the building may be shifted when the nearest position is not usable.
settings.consequence: 0 means no forward search: the first position is used or the user is asked. Larger values search further before asking.
settings.whenUnsetOrInvalid: CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE / POLICY_UNAVAILABLE naming this setting; zero inspection and zero writes.

settings.name: placement.lateralSearchCells
settings.meaning: Maximum sideways shift on each side, perpendicular to the facing direction.
settings.whenUnsetOrInvalid: CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE / POLICY_UNAVAILABLE naming this setting; zero inspection and zero writes.

settings.name: placement.verticalSearchCells
settings.meaning: Maximum up or down shift of the building's ground level from the player's feet level.
settings.consequence: 0 means the building must stand at the player's feet level.
settings.whenUnsetOrInvalid: CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE / POLICY_UNAVAILABLE naming this setting; zero inspection and zero writes.

authority.rawAnswer: 发起者优先，否则请用户选（推荐）

invariants.text: A Luanti-started turn uses the initiating player; a Shell-started turn uses the single online player; several or no online players means PlacementChoiceRequired, never a guessed player.
invariants.whyNotSwitchable: Turning it off would make the plugin pick a player the user did not choose, which the user ruled out.
invariants.consequence: The user is asked to tap a listed player name or pick an in-game point.

invariants.text: If no usable position exists inside the configured front window, the result is PlacementChoiceRequired with the reasons; the building is never moved outside the window, behind the player, or to another player.
invariants.whyNotSwitchable: A silent move would hide why the requested placement failed.
invariants.consequence: The user sees why (occupied, protected, a player's body, no ground, unknown) and picks a point or a player.

authority.rawAnswer: 列出在线玩家名字（推荐）

invariants.text: Online player names are returned only inside PlacementChoiceRequired(MULTIPLE_ONLINE_PLAYERS) to a principal whose current authorization for the bound world includes INSPECT, with revocation checked before release; Workshop offers them in Shell as typed interaction-surface/v3 ActionDescriptor.choices answered by SELECT_CHOICE (tap one); the in-world renderer does not offer the list (rc.9); no positions are ever returned.
invariants.whyNotSwitchable: The user agreed to list names only to a user authorized for the bound world.
invariants.consequence: An unauthorized or revoked caller gets a typed error and no names.

authority.basis: player position is player data; user decision text: 不显示位置

invariants.text: Raw player positions, yaw/look direction and collision boxes are read inside the Luanti payload, used once, and never returned, persisted outside the Adapter's own engine state, or logged. Only the chosen region bounds (the building's location) and a cardinal entranceFacing leave the Adapter.
invariants.consequence: Consumers cannot reconstruct a player's exact position or view.

authority.ref: CONTRACT_RULES.md#5 (每一实际写格重新检查 … 不能使用间距4采样)

invariants.text: Protection is checked per cell with the chained engine is_protected for the acting principal at InspectRegion, at Prepare and at Apply; is_area_protected lattice sampling is never used as authorization.
invariants.consequence: Protected cells produce FRONT_AREA_PROTECTED at inspection and PERMISSION_DENIED / SCOPE_DENIED at Prepare.

authority.ref: approved 2.1.0-rc.1 CONTRACT_RULES.md:41 (运行时再次检查权限和身体占用)

invariants.text: Prepare rechecks every connected player's actual collision box against every effect cell before the durable barrier.
invariants.whyNotSwitchable: A player could otherwise be enclosed by a building.
invariants.consequence: SAFETY_INVARIANT_FAILED / validate / SCOPE_DENIED with zero writes.

invariants.text: When operations.targetFactsDigest equals the digest of a REGION_INSPECTED record Canvas holds, ApplyRecoverableCommit requires regionInspectionBinding naming that Canvas-issued durable inspection record, and PROTECTION and BODY_CLEARANCE witness evidence must equal the record. An Apply whose facts digest Canvas has no record of is not recognised as a region build; for such an unrecorded first-building facts digest, Adapter Prepare's per-cell protection and player-body recheck is the backstop.
invariants.consequence: PERMISSION_DENIED / authorize / IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED with zero writes.
invariants.rc9Amendment: Q1: text aligned to the approved executable digest-triggered rule (CONTRACT_RULES.md "Evidence at Apply"; profile ApplyRecoverableCommitRequest rule); no semantic change

authority.ref: CONTRACT_RULES.md#1 (所有需要的事实/profile/limits 必须来自真实 provider)

invariants.text: The Adapter returns the complete Frame and computes frameDigest from it; it never takes a frame or frameDigest from a consumer.
invariants.whyNotSwitchable: Provider facts must come from the provider.
invariants.consequence: A frame not matching the inspected frameDigest is rejected (painter TARGET_FACTS_STALE, Brush NON_CANONICAL_AMBIGUITY).

invariants.text: REGION_INSPECTED facts are consumed only by the picture-blocks painter for a first new building; the interior painter rejects them.
invariants.whyNotSwitchable: Landed interior edits require a real inspected object.

attributedEngineCaps.kind: attributed engine/host Limit, not a product setting
attributedEngineCaps.text: If the candidate window or footprint exceeds an actual engine/host capacity, InspectRegion returns LIMIT_EXCEEDED with the attributed Limit (source, sourceRevision, actual, limit) already defined by PublicCapabilities.limits; no truncation or silent shrink.
